texto.es: Llama al +1 786-597-2216 para confirmar la ubicación y el horario de hoy antes de salir.
texto.en: Call +1 786-597-2216 to check today's spot and hours before you head out.

texto.es: Carne en vara, parrillada, pepitos o tequenos, a la parrilla al momento.
texto.en: Carne en vara, parrillada, pepitos or tequenos, grilled fresh to order.

texto.es: Todo se cocina al momento sobre fuego abierto, al estilo tradicional venezolano.
texto.en: Everything is cooked on the spot over an open flame, the traditional Venezuelan way.

texto.es: Toma asiento junto al truck o pide para llevar, el mismo sabor en ambos casos.
texto.en: Grab a seat at the truck or take it to go, same great flavor either way.

nota.es: Los precios no están publicados en línea. Llámanos y te contamos qué hay en la parrilla hoy.
nota.en: Prices are not published online. Call us and we will tell you what is on the grill today.

texto.es: Carne de res asada en vara, el plato que le da nombre al truck, cocinada a fuego abierto. Se cotiza, escríbenos.
texto.en: Grilled skewered beef, the dish that gives the truck its name, cooked over an open flame. Ask about pricing.

texto.es: Una tabla cargada de carne, chorizo y costillas de cerdo a la parrilla con yuca frita y queso de mano. Se cotiza, escríbenos.
texto.en: A loaded platter of grilled beef, chorizo and pork ribs with fried yuca and queso de mano. Ask about pricing.

texto.es: Sándwiches y hot dogs al estilo venezolano, cargados de papitas y salsas de la casa. Se cotiza, escríbenos.
texto.en: Loaded Venezuelan-style sandwiches and hot dogs, piled high with shoestring potatoes and house sauces. Ask about pricing.

texto.es: Tequenos de queso crujientes y chicharrón de cerdo, tal como dicen las reseñas que debe ser. Se cotiza, escríbenos.
texto.en: Crispy cheese tequenos and crunchy pork chicharron, just the way reviewers say it should be done. Ask about pricing.

pie.es: ¿No ves algo que se te antoja? Llámanos, el menú cambia según lo fresco del día.
pie.en: Don't see something you are craving? Call us, the menu changes with what's fresh.

items.quote: The most authentic Venezuelan place in Broward! the atmosphere was amazing family place very safe. The food was to die for looking forward to comeback definitely my top 5!

My experience was wonderful. Got very nice service while ordering and a few laughs thanks to Julio. Food was great, first time having it. I would definitely recommend and come back. 10/10 all across the board.
Very pleasantly surprised! The tequenos with sauce were amazing. The chicharron was tasty and crunchy, just how it should be.
